description: This file defines a Smarty plugin for formatting text blocks with various styling and wrapping options. It includes the main function smarty_block_textformat that processes content blocks with parameters such as style, indentation, and wrapping rules.

methods.name: smarty_block_textformat
methods.description: Formats a content block with specified styling options such as indentation, wrapping, and style. Handles paragraph splitting, spacing normalization, and line indentation based on parameters, and optionally assigns the output to a template variable.
